name: LiminalityVR
summary: LiminalityVR is a fan-made VR game inspired by Gorilla Tag's locomotion, but with a thrilling twist into the realm of horror. Players navigate through eerie environments filled with suspenseful moments and unexpected scares, all while utilizing the dynamic parkour mechanics reminiscent of Gorilla Tag.
